checks.name: notes_present
checks.detail: no notes were extracted. n_kon_effective tells you which case this is: zero means nothing was ever keyed on in this window (a drone already sounding at the snapshot), non-zero means key-ons were seen and the extractor failed to pair them

checks.name: no_unhandled_registers
checks.detail: a DSP register this extractor does not model was written, so something about the track is not represented

checks.name: some_notes_completed
checks.detail: every note still sounding at the end means no key-off was ever observed, so no duration in this track is real

checks.name: durations_positive
checks.detail: a note ending at or before it started means key-on and key-off were paired wrongly

checks.name: notes_within_render
checks.detail: a note starting after the render ended means the timestamp base is wrong -- the symptom an earlier chunk-relative clock produced

checks.name: writes_span_render
checks.detail: DSP writes stopped well before the end of the render, so the driver halted or looped into silence and most of the window is not music

checks.name: audio_not_silent
